payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 1 explicitly requires the witness to drive one ORPHANED task 'whose review carries one anchored concern,' to prove that a mere concern does not block admission the way a blocker does. The added test `test_ready_task_rebuilds_an_orphaned_task_whose_cell_went_green` instead reuses `_rt_orphaned_task`, which seeds `findings.json` as an empty list via `_rt_seed_records`, so no review ever contains a concern, anchored or otherwise. Widening the `anchored_blockers(reviews)` check at this line to also treat an anchored `concern` as blocking (e.g. requiring a rebuttal for it too) would be wrong per the spec, but every test in the new ORPHANED suite stays green, because none of them exercises a concern-only review.
